anomalies.description: A dark-colored car loses control, veers off the road, and collides violently with a tree, producing a large dust/debris cloud upon impact.; A vehicle (likely a motorcycle or scooter) collides with a tree in a parking lot, generating a large dust/debris cloud that obscures the scene; the vehicle appears to be thrown sideways upon impact and remains on the ground afterward.

A sudden, violent burst of dust and debris occurs at the moment of impact between the car and the tree, consistent with a high-energy collision causing a localized explosion-like effect (e.g., tire rupture, fuel vapor ignition, or structural disintegration).

A white semi-trailer truck loses control, jackknifes, and overturns onto its side across the road, blocking both lanes. The cab and trailer separate during the rollover, with dust and debris visible as the vehicle comes to rest.
